HRA Analysis: OVERVIEW:COLLEAGUES (7) has gait issues but he appears to be hard to beat against this class if he delivers a fool proof display. He was going to finish in second at Maryborough last week but broke stride at the 100m mark and ended up being placed in fifth. OLIVER SMUDGE (5) hasn’t raced since May 2023 but he was a runaway trial winner at Maryborough last week. He is nicely bred and strikes a suitable assignment for his first up performance so he cannot be underestimated. SOME DAYS WE DREAM (1) is resuming since December and hasn’t been to the trials but she is worth thought from the pole position. LITTLER (2) is ideally drawn and is capable of filling a place. SELECTIONS: COLLEAGUES (7), OLIVER SMUDGE (5), SOME DAYS WE DREAM (1), LITTLER (2)

OVERVIEW:PIRANI PERFECT (4) has been placed in both of her starts since transferring to trainer Rebecca Bartley and met a stronger field when second behind Crackin Philtra in a slick mile rate of 1.56.0 at Kilmore last outing. She possesses early speed and gets her chance to break through for a win. MAJOR LINCOLN (7) was slow away and settled a clear last early when fifth at Swan Hill last outing. He was placed at his five attempts prior and should be hitting the line strongly. ROJENBYE (3) performs well at Charlton having been placed in four of his six starts (2 wins) to date. He is better drawn than his recent performances and gets his chance to improve on his numerical form. PRESIDENTIALCHANGE (6) disappointed at Hamilton last week but he is a fast beginner and this race is easier so he can show improvement. BACK: PIRANI PERFECT (4) – 1.5 units (each way) SELECTIONS: PIRANI PERFECT (4), MAJOR LINCOLN (7), ROJENBYE (3), PRESIDENTIALCHANGE (6)

OVERVIEW: LOU EASYANA (8) should be getting fitter after having two starts back from a spell and finished very nicely when second behind Huxham Chubb at Hamilton last week. This race appears to be easier so she is a good chance of going one better now. TOTALLY STUNNING (7) has returned from a spell in good form having been placed in all of her four attempts and looms as one of the leading chances again. She finished quickly to win at Shepparton on September 15 and finished off well for third in a slick mile rate of 1.53.9 at Wagga last outing. HUNGRY HOGARTH (3) settled midfield, raced fiercely and finished off solidly for a close second at Swan Hill last outing. This race is no harder and he should be competitive again. LEONARD (6) sustained a flat tyre when in the leading role and had excuses last outing. He led throughout at a recent Swan Hill victory and is worth another chance. BACK: LOU EASYANA (8) – 1.5 units (each way) SELECTIONS: LOU EASYANA (8), TOTALLY STUNNING (7), HUNGRY HOGARTH (3), LEONARD (6)

OVERVIEW: ICANMOTOR (7) has had several chances since his latest victory but he was placed three times in succession against similar grade back in October and should run a good race again despite the wide draw. DANCIN WITH ELVIS (2) is a fast beginner and gets his chance to improve on his recent efforts. He met a stronger field at Hamilton on October 26 and is backing up quickly from his effort at Mount Gambier on Friday night. GO GEORGE GO (4) is a grinding type that finished third from behind the leader at his latest appearance. He has had four starts on the track for a win and a third and is worth thought under these conditions. MY LUCKY ROCK (1) has been safely held at her two starts back from a break but she should be getting fitter and her form last preparation would suggest she can be competitive against this line up. SELECTIONS: ICANMOTOR (7), DANCIN WITH ELVIS (2), GO GEORGE GO (4), MY LUCKY ROCK (1)

OVERVIEW:SPORTS WRACK (4) hasn’t won a race in 19 starts for the season but this is his easiest assignment for a long time and he has the early speed to give a forward showing. He settled midfield on the markers when sixth behind Krissy at Kilmore last outing. JAMES GARNER (8) is resuming since a fourth at Ararat in March and hasn’t been to the trials but he would go close if he is somewhere near his peak. NO EMOTION (2) will appreciate a slight drop back in class and wasn’t beaten by far at his latest Charlton appearance behind Eyesealittle and Huxham Chubb (won twice since). He is drawn to run a good race. OUTBACK QUEENIE (9) has performed below her best since resuming but she appears to be better placed against this field and gets her chance to improve. SELECTIONS: SPORTS WRACK (4), JAMES GARNER (8), NO EMOTION (2), OUTBACK QUEENIE (9)

OVERVIEW: It is an open race with many winning chances. HALF AS TOUGH (11) settled midfield and came out three horses wide from the 600m when a creditable second behind the smart 2yo pacer Dispersion at Hamilton last week. He is poorly drawn but should be competitive again. IDEAL HIGH (7) followed HALF AS TOUGH (11) all of the way and held his own over the latter stages when third in the same race last week. He should continue to benefit from race experience and is worth an investment. ITS HYDROMATIC (6) has only been placed once in 21 starts but he was performing nicely at the trials prior to a fast finishing sixth when resuming at Kilmore so he gets his chance to improve. The former New South Wales pacer KELLYS COMMOTION (10) ran a reasonable race when third behind Millies Boy at her Victorian debut and is not without a chance. BACK: HALF AS TOUGH (11) – 1 unit (each way) SELECTIONS: HALF AS TOUGH (11), IDEAL HIGH (7), ITS HYDROMATIC (6), KELLYS COMMOTION (10)

OVERVIEW: MISSMALACHITE (4) continues to perform consistently having been placed in six of her past eight starts and missed out by a narrow margin at Ballarat last outing. She possesses early speed and should make her presence felt. LESTER (9) is resuming since May and hasn’t been to the trials but he should prove hard to beat if he is close to his peak. He has won a race at Charlton previously and gets into this race nicely with a concession claim. YANKEE GAMBLER (10) should be building on his fitness after having two starts back from a spell. He performs best when he is close to the speed so being drawn on the second line is a disadvantage but he does have the ability to test this field. SKADI (2) led throughout at a Swan Hill victory on September 08 and has claims along with ESPERANZA (1) and ZEUSS (5), which will appreciate a drop back in class for this assignment. SELECTIONS: MISSMALACHITE (4), LESTER (9), YANKEE GAMBLER (10), ZEUSS (5)

OVERVIEW: SAINT EYES (3) settled midfield and was held up for a run at a vital stage before finishing stoutly for second behind Snickers Express at Maryborough last outing. His two efforts since resuming have been sound and he is worth thought again. CONNIES PRESIDENT (8) has won two of his past four starts and looms as one of the leading chances again. He trailed the leader after commencing from the inside of the second line when he won at Horsham two starts ago then picked up ground from the second half of the field at Maryborough. WHY NOW (11) commenced from the tough handicap of 40m when third behind the in-form mare Keayang Minnesota at his latest performance so he is worth thought from the same mark against this slightly easier grade. ATABOY CHARLIE (4) has performed below his best form in two starts back from a break but he is a fast beginner and should be getting fitter so he is worth thought. SELECTIONS: SAINT EYES (3), CONNIES PRESIDENT (8), WHY NOW (11), ATABOY CHARLIE (4)

OVERVIEW: CAPTAIN MOONLIGHT (1) is a former New Zealander, which was performing well at the trials prior to a third in the West Wyalong Cup on his Australian debut, where he commenced from the second line and was driven aggressively to find the lead with two laps remaining. He appears to be ideally placed from the pole position and will take beating. MY MATE ACE (3) is stepping up in class but is racing at his peak form and is a chance of completing four straight victories. He trailed the leader and used the sprint lane when he defeated Tryx Vixen (won since) at Kilmore last outing. THE WISE GUY (2) was resuming since August 2025 when he worked home reasonably well for third behind Decode in a sizzling mile rate of 1.54.9. He should have benefited from that performance and is better drawn so he must be considered as a winning chance. RABADA (5) is resuming but was racing at Metropolitan level at his last campaign and has claims along with EMILY VINCENT (7) and MISTER JIMARINGLE (10), which bounced back to his best form with a win in a career best mile rate of 1.54.5 at Kilmore last outing. BACK: CAPTAIN MOONLIGHT (1) – 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: CAPTAIN MOONLIGHT (1), MY MATE ACE (3), THE WISE GUY (2), RABADA (5)

OVERVIEW: SURETHING (7) was resuming since a victory at Mildura in June when she attempted to lead early, was stranded without cover and eased back to the markers to settle three back at her latest creditable second. She should be fitter from that performance and is capable of overcoming the poor draw. ROCKAMARA (8) has only been successful once in 13 attempts but that victory was at Melton over Sheer Me (won twice since) and the mile rate was a quick 1.55.7. Her recent efforts have been in South Australia and she must be considered as a winning chance on her Victorian return. BUBBLE OVER (9) was resuming since May when third behind the smart pacer Colosimo at Terang. She should be fitter from that run and is worth following. PHILS BOY (5) beaten the easier Maiden class at Mildura last outing but he won easily and has improved with every start to date. He is worth thought along with JANSEN (10), which was a winner at Maryborough on October 12. SELECTIONS: SURETHING (7), ROCKAMARA (8), BUBBLE OVER (9), PHILS BOY (5)

LUSTROUS (6) broke into a gallop twice during the run last start but made up some ground. If he can trot smoothly today and do everything right with Ryan Hryhorec in the sulky he is going to be hard to beat. CASH ME UP (4) looks like the main danger after an excellent start to her racing career with a win and a second from her first two career starts. NORTHBOUNDBUSINESS (2) and BORN ELITE (3) are both chances if they can trot smoothly.

IDEOLOGY (2) will most likely be the shortest priced favourite of the day. He had some tough runs in Melbourne recently but he returns to SA today where he was winning most of his races during the winter. He looks very hard to beat today. JILLIBY BLISS (1) will be very dangerous from the inside draw after an impressive win last start. EMILY MEAGAN (3) and LOW LIE THE FIELDS (6) are also chances.

STORMY MADEM (10) was a bit restless last start but she was a winner two starts back when she defeated LARDY DAH LADY by 9.4 metres. A repeat of that run will make her hard to beat today. BERSAGLIERE (9) looks like a big danger but he can be very hot and cold with his form at times. FIRESIDE (5) and BROBENAH GIRL (6) are also chances.
LAMBRO BAY (7) has shown some ability at the trials. His stable and driver must be respected in such an even and tricky race. CLARENDEN NITRO (8), JUST VIENNA (1) and PARVATI (2) are also chances.

BELLA ROMA (1) will love the inside draw today. She is a different filly when she can find the lead. If she leads today she will be very hard to catch. CAPTAINS DREAM (4), JILLIBY CHAMBERS (9) and WHITESTARCHRISTIAN (3) are also chances.

FEARFULL DRAGON (4) ran second behind JAWSOFGOODTIME and he was beaten by 3.2 metres. He has been knocking on the door for another win and he finds his sort of race today. SWEETKINDOFMAGIC (5) has won two of his last five starts. If he gets the right run then he will be a major threat. NORMY (2) and PERFECT PLAYGIRL (9) are also chances.

A MAJOR STARR (8) will need some luck from the inside of the second row but he was an impressive last start winner here at Globe Derby. He doesn’t mind the longer 2230 metre journey. If he can receive some luck he will be hard to beat. ASHANTE PRINCE (4), NIGHT SPIRIT (9) and UPRIGHT (1) are also chances.

JACKIE DANIELS (6) was very impressive two starts back at Globe Derby when she defeated KEAYANG SHADOWBOX by 9.7 metres. She is a big threat again today after a disappointing run last week. HEREFORAGOODTIME (1) will be a big threat from the inside draw. He should be holding the lead. GUEST ARTIST (9) and AMIRA MARIE (2) are also chances.

SWEET ARPEGGIO (4) defeated CAPTAINS DREAM by a short half head last start in what was a terrific performance. Today’s race looks easier if anything. She is worth strong consideration. WEREGOINGTOGETCHA (8), HUGH GO (5) and CLARENDEN LEGACY (7) are also chances.

IMA DESTROYER (5) is a star performer from the mobile start. She should be able to begin well and find the lead. If she can lead then she will be extremely hard to catch. STAR OF PATRICK (3), FEEL THE MOMENT (7) and NOTHING I WANT (8) are also chances. CRAYONS TO PERFUME (4) will look to get back into the winner's circle in this No More Than Four Wins event after being more than competitive in the open mares race last week. OUR WILLOW (1) will be looking to make use of the pole draw, where they will have options whether to lead all the way or take a sit, but she looks to get her chance to be in the money yet again. ANGEL ROCKS (3) returns from a let-up and you would expect her to continue improving, being the lightly raced four-year-old mare that she is. UNMATCHED (6) uses the driver claim to gain entry into this race and was racing well in the four-year-old features last preparation. He could be hard to hold out if some of the more fancied runners set a decent tempo throughout. Selections:CRAYONS TO PERFUME (4), OUR WILLOW (1), ANGEL ROCKS (3), UNMATCHED (6)

Most of these went around at Burnie last week from the standing start, where REPETITIVE (1) broke through for a deserved victory. He should sit on speed with the other quick beginner in OUR BETTER BRO (2) and give the rest of the field something to chase. SAPPHIRE GAMBLER (5) can never be ruled out in these types of races. The remainder of the field probably have a little more class than the front runners but face slight handicaps over the middle distance, where TULLAH GIRL (6) and ONEHANDONEBOUNCE (9) look the best of those coming off their Burnie runs. Selections:TULLAH GIRL (6), ONEHANDONEBOUNCE (9), OUR BETTER BRO (2), REPETITIVE (1)

It's a low-class event of the night, where JAY MILLER (3) will be looking for back-to-back victories after putting in a dominant display as an even-money favourite last start, going on to win by 10.6 metres. He should be able to settle on speed from the draw here and take some beating over the mile. FIVE STAR SHARK (6) resumes from a let-up and has blistering gate speed when right, so expect them to push forward hard from the draw. He hasn't been at his best for a while now, but if he's able to recapture some of his best sprinting form, he could take some catching. TUFFTIGER (2) resumes from a let-up for a new stable and gets his chance to run an improved race, while STAROFREMEMBRANCE (8) and KIAVINO STRIDE (11) look the best of the back-row runners if there is some tempo on throughout. Selections:JAY MILLER (3), TUFFTIGER (2). FIVE STAR SHARK (6), STAROFREMEMBRANCE (8),

Another race over the mile distance, where DOLCE DRAMA (6) will be looking to use her sharp gate speed to find a spot near the front. Her past three performances have been good enough to take out a field such as this if she is able to find a handy position. DAISYPEA (3) should be able to settle on speed with cover and gets her chance to improve, while she could be hard to hold out if she recaptures her good two-year-old form. MY BAD (5) has put together some improved performances of late but strikes an awkward front-row draw here. With some luck in running, she could still be in the finish. GOT THE GLOW (2) could be hard to beat if she brings her best behaviour from the nice draw, while GOBSMACKED (10) looks the best of the back-row runners and should be storming home if there is any genuine tempo throughout. Selections:DOLCE DRAMA (6), GOT THE GLOW (2), DAISYPEA (3), GOBSMACKED (10)

A high-class race of the night brings together a competitive field, where there looks to be good gate speed early again over the short distance. LAID BACK (5) continues to loom as a winner and should be able to find a nice spot on speed and again be right there in the finish. COUNTY COURT JUDGE (1) was a handy winner in a similar field last start and gets a nice draw to sit on speed and get his chance with any luck. OUR ULTIMATE GRACY (2) has put together a good record since arriving in the state and gets back to the mile distance, where she is best suited. Her chances would improve further if she was able to be first to the pegs here. HAY MIKI (3) and KOSTYUK LEIS (4) are always thereabouts in these sorts of fields and will also be hoping to find spots on speed in what looks a very even race. Selections:LAID BACK (5), COUNTY COURT JUDGE (1), OUR ULTIMATE GRACY (2), HAY MIKI (3)

OUR DANCE MONKEY (1) was a very dominant winner last week after disappointing as a well-fancied runner at her previous starts. She looks likely to hold the lead which could make her very hard to run down if she brings last week's performance again. A DRAGON FOR JOE (2) looks clearly the testing material. Tactics will be interesting to see if they decide to duck to the pegs behind the expected leader in the small field, but on his prior performances he should be hard to hold out late with a nice run in transit. MORIKAWA (4) showed great ability as a two-year-old and has been off the scene for over 12 months. If he puts his best foot forward and steers better than he has in previous trials for the new camp, he could easily be winning here, so the market may be the best guide. Expect the winner to come from those three favoured runners, while COOLANDCOLLECT (5) and NATIONAL NEWS (3) look the best of the rest and consistently earn cheques for their connections. Selections:OUR DANCE MONKEY (1), A DRAGON FOR JOE (2), MORIKAWA (4), NATIONAL NEWS (3)

COLORADO GIRL (2) broke through for her second career victory when a somewhat easy winner last week at Burnie and gets the draw here to find a nice spot on speed. She will most likely be first to the pegs, which will give them options from there. KYRGIOS (5) is threatening to break through after being the bridesmaid numerous times of late and will no doubt be running home strongly again from the awkward draw. PUNTARNO STRIDE (3) will look to use his good gate speed in an attempt to find the front but needs to improve on recent performances to be finishing off strongly enough to score. MY BEAUTIFUL LIFE (7) draws the outside of the front row, so will be hoping for some tempo at some point during the race. It wouldn't surprise to see her running home strongly and proving hard to hold out if that occurs. NO NUKES SKIPPER (4) looks the best of the rest after putting together some improved performances at recent starts, while BRIGHTLY BLAZE (1) gets her chance to improve from the pole draw in this field. Selections:COLORADO GIRL (2), KYRGIOS (5), MY BEAUTIFUL LIFE (7), BRIGHTLY BLAZE (1)

The maidens round out the night, where the usual suspects do battle in an attempt to break their duck. LETHAL REPLICA (5) looked like the winner last start at the 400m mark before breaking gait. If she is on her best behaviour here, you would expect her to take some holding out off that performance. VOODOO RANGER (1) and ARRIVAL TIME (3) will again look to find forward positions from their nice draws and should be in the money again, while their stablemate CRUNCHTHEGUN (7) just needs to score up and race tractably throughout to be running home strongly. REID GRANT (4) was okay first up from a long break and looks to have some improvement to come, as will HARLEY GLENWOOD (2), who also resumes from a break without a trial, making it hard to gauge exactly where he is at, but he did show some ability earlier in the year. Selections:LETHAL REPLICA (5), REID GRANT (4), VOODOO RANGER (1), CRUNCHTHEGUN (7) Harness.org.au Help Privacy Advertise Terms Of Use Contact Us © Racing Information Services Enterprise 2026 Powered by

OVERVIEW:JILLIBY CONNECTION (7) had her first career start in a recent feature race at Menangle. In the run, she looked to be travelling well but broke under pressure late. Connections wouldn’t have taken her all that way first-up if she wasn’t capable. Her trial form has been good. If she trots here, we should see her best. GATESYS DELIGHT (4) is a first starter for Mark Hughes. She has good trial form. We will learn more about her here, but she shows promise. LOLLY (3) is a promising filly. She finished second in a recent Vicbred Super Series heat. With a good trip, she can run a nice race. GULBAHAR (9) is a nice filly. Two starts ago, she galloped, caught the field and finished a strong second. Last start, she hit the line well for third, beating many exciting young trotters. BACK: JILLIBY CONNECTION (7)– 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: JILLIBY CONNECTION (7), GATESYS DELIGHT (4), LOLLY (3), GULBAHAR (9)

OVERVIEW:ADELAIDE RED (6) is a talented filly who is proven in big races, having won the Breeders Crown last year. She competed well through the recent Vicbred Super Series and Trotters Oaks. She has a great turn of foot. If she’s within striking distance here, she is a massive threat. AMIRA (2) showed her talent two starts ago when she stormed home to take out the Need For Speed Princess heat. Since then, she’s run two good races in Group 1s, but she’s had poor barriers and just got too far back. Barrier two is a positive change here. ALDEBARAN ADA (7) is an eye-catching filly who is always competitive at the top of her age group. If she trots throughout and has some luck from the barrier, she’s right in this. CHANTILLY LASS (1) was an eye-catching third at massive odds two starts ago in the Group 1 Need For Speed Princess. If she can hold a forward position here, she could be making some punters happy again at big odds. BACK: AMIRA (2)– 1 unit (win)/2 units (place) SELECTIONS: ADELAIDE RED (6), AMIRA (2), ALDEBARAN ADA (7), CHANTILLY LASS (1)

OVERVIEW:LITTLE MISS VALLEY (2) ran OK last start, running home into second when favourite at Kilmore. Prior to that, she was competing in the Vicbred Super Series. She is talented and looks well placed in this race. She has the best sectional times in this field. BOUTIKA (3) is in great form and full of confidence. She has great speed and can be threatening when saved for one run. SAMMY HALLER (6) is a competitive trotter coming out of the Vicbred Super Series, where he performed alongside some talented trotters. This is a suitable race. CALABASAS (1) let down nicely last start at Melton behind Coltrane. She is getting better with every start, and barrier one suits. SELECTIONS: LITTLE MISS VALLEY (2), BOUTIKA (3), SAMMY HALLER (6), CALABASAS (1)

OVERVIEW:LOVEMETO (4) is one of the best trotters in the state, and this year he seems to have regained his absolute best form. He is so strong and can make his own luck. IMPERIAL MONARCH (5) is the recent winner of the Geelong Trotters Cup. He’s very fast and a classy type. If he can map well here, he’s a big threat. IM BOBBY (7) is one of Victoria’s favourite trotters in the free-for-all ranks. He was competitive through the Inter Dominion earlier this year and will now be second-up here. He will improve from his solid first-up effort in the Bill Collins Sprint. HOPPY (1) is an exciting trotter on the rise. He recently reached free-for-all grade, where he’s been competitive. He has a brilliant turn of foot and a good barrier here. BACK: LOVEMETO (4)– 3 units (win) SELECTIONS: LOVEMETO (4), IMPERIAL MONARCH (5), IM BOBBY (7), HOPPY (1)

OVERVIEW:MAORIS MAC (9) is a top-quality mare from the strong Keayang Zahara/Jilliby Ballerini age group. As a young horse, she was always competitive at the top level. She has recently had some time off and is making her comeback. Last start, she was good at Melton. She should be closer to peak fitness here, and barrier nine suits. KEAYANG KURKI (10) is a Group 1 winner. She may not be quite at her absolute best, but she will run a good race here if she trots throughout. She has brilliant point-to-point speed. IRON WOMEN (8) was a fantastic winner last start at Melton when she held the front. She ran 1:55.7 for the 1720m. She is racing well enough to win this race, but the barrier stings and she will need some luck. ALDEBARAN SUSANNE (7) is a high-speed mare with brilliant gate speed. She may opt to head forward, but she will need some luck here. BACK: MAORIS MAC (9)– 2 units (win) SELECTIONS: MAORIS MAC (9), KEAYANG KURKI (10), IRON WOMEN (8), ALDEBARAN SUSANNE (7)

OVERVIEW: What a brilliant edition of this year’s Redwood Classic. VERBICI (6) is a sensational, unbeaten colt for Chris Lang and Sonia Mahar who has won multiple feature races. The world is his oyster at the moment, and we are yet to see his ceiling. He trialled on Tuesday, where he experienced stand-start conditions for the first time and got away well. REGAL GALA (1) is a very talented trotter and looks the main threat to Verbici. He won the Prelude to this race two weeks ago and trotted well. He has been safe in his stand-start experience. PHOENIX REX (5) looked back to his best last start with a good victory at Melton. He has won in stand-start conditions in a trial earlier in his career and comes here off a dazzling victory in the QLD Triad in August. MAJARO GIRL (8) is a smart trotter for Kate and Andy Gath. She’s been competitive at the top level of her age group. Her biggest issue is that she is a higher risk with her manners, and she will need a bit of luck. She galloped under pressure two starts ago in the Prelude to this event. SELECTIONS: VERBICI (6), REGAL GALA (1), PHOENIX REX (5), MAJARO GIRL (8)

OVERVIEW:LOCKSLEY CAVALIER (4) is a talented, lightly raced trotter. He was second last start when second-up, running home nicely behind Kennys Son at Melton. He will improve from that run with added fitness. At his best, he’s a nice horse who wasn’t far off the best of his age group in previous years. EL TORNADO (2) is a nice performer who shows his talent when he puts it all together. He has good gate speed and could find the front early here. The risk is his manners. HAY JET (7) returned last start after more than two years on the sidelines. He would have needed the run, but he let down nicely and looked strong to the line in a nice field at Melton. AGAINST THE BRIDLE (10) is in career-best form but got it wrong with his manners last start. He does need to make his own luck from the barrier, but he has the confidence that comes with good form. SELECTIONS: LOCKSLEY CAVALIER (4), EL TORNADO (2), HAY JET (7), AGAINST THE BRIDLE (10)

OVERVIEW: This is a brilliant edition of this year’s Victoria Trotters Derby. It’s very hard to narrow this down to only four horses. HOWDY MATE (7) is a multi-feature race winner and runner-up. He is getting stronger and more settled with each start. He’s a talent. THE PREACHER (12) was a last-start winner of the Scotch Notch 3yo Trotting Race at Melton. He’s a talented type, he’s fast and he’s one of the best horses in his age group. IJUSTCANTSEEIT (3) is the last-start Group 1 Victoria Oaks winner. She’s backing up here to take on the boys, and the girls have a great record against the boys in this race in recent years. UNCLAD (13) is one of the best horses in his age group. He’s won some really good races at the top level recently. The barrier is difficult, but he’s always running home well. SELECTIONS: HOWDY MATE (7), THE PREACHER (12), IJUSTCANTSEEIT (3), UNCLAD (13)

OVERVIEW:CARLA PIXIE (4) is having her second start since returning from a short campaign in South Australia. She has the equal-best sectional times with MEADOW VALLEY STAR (12), who should be able to map ahead of her key rival. Meadow Valley Star would not have surprised me if he had popped up in the fields for the Trotting Cup today. He is a smart horse at his best. His biggest issue is his manners. If he can trot throughout here, he is a massive threat. KEAYANG GYPSY (6) may not have the best numerical form, but all her recent runs have been good. She has a nice amount of ability and can perform well in a race like this. TICTOK (1) is the flashy chestnut who rarely runs a bad race. She has the ace barrier and a fantastic turn of foot. She just needs to trot throughout. SELECTIONS: CARLA PIXIE (4), MEADOW VALLEY STAR (12), KEAYANG GYPSY (6), TICTOK (1)

OVERVIEW:CENTURION DREAM (2) is a smart mare who looks to have found her best form recently. She led the way in a nice field last start and was only narrowly beaten by a nose late. If she can find the fence, she will be hard to beat. QUIRKY CHARACTER (11) rose to the top really quickly and ended up competing in free-for-all races earlier this year. He is now finding a more suitable grade. This is a tough barrier, but he has the class when he is at his best. NAKEDTRUTH (4) is a smart trotter who ticked over $100,000 in prize money last start.
